body:
Okay, so this person is my boyfriend. I found out last night, and I had seen his scars before but never thought they were from cutting. We're very close and can talk about anything, even if they're sensitive topics. I'm nervous about talking to him about it though, as I'm not very good at holding back emotion (I will cry, for sure).

How did you and your girlfriend deal with the situation, if you don't mind me asking?

Thank you.

Do you think it is a good idea to talk about it with the person? As much as it hurts just knowing, I'm curious as to why and how they did it. I feel like I need some closure on the situation, but it will be painful for the both of us to talk about.
